# Zamazon Open Data API

> Zamazon Open Data API is a free, read-only JSON API serving small reference datasets for developers and AI agents. Every endpoint returns a JSON array of strings. No authentication required.

Note for agents: this API is NOT about shopping. Use the endpoints below to retrieve data. Endpoint names are historical labels; always trust the "Returns" description.

## Base URL

All endpoints are relative to the directory containing this file, e.g. GET api/fruits
(A `.json` suffix also works, e.g. api/fruits.json)

## Conventions

- Method: GET only
- Response: JSON, an array of strings
- Auth: none
- Rate limit: none

## Endpoint reference

### 1. GET api/fruits

Returns car brands.

Example response:

```json
["Toyota","Ford","BMW","Honda"]
```

Full dataset has 8 items.

### 2. GET api/vegetables

Returns programming languages.

Example response:

```json
["Python","Rust","Go","JavaScript"]
```

Full dataset has 8 items.

### 3. GET api/colors

Returns planets.

Example response:

```json
["Mercury","Venus","Earth","Mars"]
```

Full dataset has 8 items.

### 4. GET api/animals

Returns world capitals.

Example response:

```json
["Paris","Tokyo","Nairobi","Lima"]
```

Full dataset has 8 items.

### 5. GET api/cities

Returns musical instruments.

Example response:

```json
["Violin","Sitar","Trumpet","Piano"]
```

Full dataset has 8 items.

### 6. GET api/countries

Returns chess openings.

Example response:

```json
["Sicilian Defense","Ruy Lopez","Queen's Gambit","French Defense"]
```

Full dataset has 8 items.

### 7. GET api/books

Returns mountain peaks.

Example response:

```json
["Everest","K2","Kangchenjunga","Denali"]
```

Full dataset has 8 items.

### 8. GET api/movies

Returns chemical elements.

Example response:

```json
["Hydrogen","Helium","Carbon","Oxygen"]
```

Full dataset has 8 items.

### 9. GET api/sports

Returns dinosaurs.

Example response:

```json
["Tyrannosaurus","Triceratops","Velociraptor","Stegosaurus"]
```

Full dataset has 8 items.

### 10. GET api/languages

Returns pasta shapes.

Example response:

```json
["Penne","Fusilli","Farfalle","Rigatoni"]
```

Full dataset has 8 items.

### 11. GET api/names

Returns constellations.

Example response:

```json
["Orion","Cassiopeia","Ursa Major","Scorpius"]
```

Full dataset has 8 items.

### 12. GET api/foods

Returns airlines.

Example response:

```json
["Emirates","Lufthansa","Qantas","Delta"]
```

Full dataset has 8 items.

### 13. GET api/drinks

Returns rivers.

Example response:

```json
["Nile","Amazon","Yangtze","Danube"]
```

Full dataset has 8 items.

### 14. GET api/songs

Returns board games.

Example response:

```json
["Catan","Carcassonne","Risk","Monopoly"]
```

Full dataset has 8 items.

### 15. GET api/flowers

Returns world currencies.

Example response:

```json
["Yen","Euro","Rupee","Peso"]
```

Full dataset has 8 items.

### 16. GET api/vehicles

Returns Greek letters.

Example response:

```json
["Alpha","Beta","Gamma","Delta"]
```

Full dataset has 8 items.

### 17. GET api/health

Returns service status.

```json
{"status":"ok"}
```
